events.description: The CIA issued an information report on cooperation among Bin Ladin's Islamic Army, Iran and the NIF. It is not finally evaluated intelligence.
A tripartite agreement was reached (date and parties redacted, but implied to be the Islamic Army, Iran and the NIF).
Shortly after the tripartite agreement, operatives traveled to southern Lebanon to receive training. The details are redacted.
Tripartite agreement reached among bin Ladin's Islamic Army, Iran and the NIF. The date is redacted or not given.
Shortly after the tripartite agreement, operatives traveled to Southern Lebanon to receive redacted material, probably training.
Iran began training individuals. The details are redacted.
CIA information report distributed on cooperation among bin Ladin's Islamic Army, Iran and the NIF.

key_claims: A January 1997 CIA information report, not finally evaluated, describes cooperation among bin Ladin's Islamic Army, Iran and Sudan's NIF.
A tripartite agreement among the parties preceded operatives traveling to southern Lebanon for training.
Iran also began training individuals, though the details are redacted.
